instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after actor evidence exists and an independent critic artifact approves or waives completion.

features.description: Current assistant runtime maturity is assessed against current agent-runtime practices, with stale prior-summary claims corrected against repository evidence.
steps: Inspect assistant runtime, middleware, approval, trace/eval, context/cache, and validation surfaces.
Record industry research sources and repo facts in source-packet.md and optimization-plan.md.
Write a baseline report and critic artifact that say which optimization phases are unlocked.
features.evidence: Actor report: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-00-baseline-runtime-and-industry-audit-report.md; critic artifact: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-00-baseline-runtime-and-industry-audit-critic.md; validations: strict harness 100, assistant baseline 33 passed, route traceparent test 1 passed, eval trace baseline 47 passed, targeted ruff passed, frontend eslint/type-check passed.
features.notes: ARO-00 passed with documented scope expansion to repair baseline contract drift: RAG retrieval stream events, AssistantConfig trace fields, and chat route traceparent wiring.

features.description: Agent middleware lifecycle and human approval/resume path become complete enough to support reliability middleware without broad AgentLoop rewrites.
steps: Wire on_stream_event and on_error in MiddlewareChain with failure-isolation tests.
Add call limit, loop detection, time budget, pre-completion checklist, and trace sensor middleware behind config where needed.
Persist CONFIRM verdicts as approval records, stream approval_id, and prove approved resume executes a tool exactly once.
features.evidence: Actor report: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-01-middleware-harness-and-approval-completion-report.md; critic artifact: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-01-middleware-harness-and-approval-completion-critic.md; validations: focused ruff passed, middleware chain 7 passed, harness middleware 5 passed, assistant runtime contract 36 passed, approval gateway contract 10 passed.
features.notes: ARO-01 added stream/error middleware hooks, non-default reliability middlewares, persisted middleware CONFIRM approval_id, approved resume, argument matching, and single-use approval consumption.

features.description: Existing assistant/langgraph/rag traces become a feedback loop that produces redacted datasets, evaluator runs, failure clusters, and reviewed harness-profile proposals.
steps: Cluster failed or low-score traces by failure mode.
Promote selected traces into redacted eval dataset cases.
Block bad harness/profile changes through evaluator or replay gates and expose failure patterns in Eval UI.
features.evidence: Actor report: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-02-trace-eval-feedback-loop-report.md; critic artifact: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-02-trace-eval-feedback-loop-critic.md; validations: focused ruff passed, required ARO-02 ruff passed, focused feedback tests 8 passed, eval regression with feedback tests 84 passed.
features.notes: ARO-02 added a self-hosted trace feedback preview API and service for assistant/langgraph_proxy/rag traces. It returns bounded failure patterns, redacted EvalExampleImportItem payloads, clusters, proposed-only harness/profile changes, and candidate gate results without SaaS dependency, DB migration, or automatic profile application. Web evidence waived because no eval UI files changed.

features.description: Long assistant runs persist checkpoint state and can resume safely after approval pauses, process restarts, or transient tool/model failures.
steps: Add additive checkpoint persistence for run phase, message state hash, pending tool, approval, iteration, and idempotency keys.
Write checkpoints around model turns and side-effecting tools.
Prove resume and duplicate-prevention behavior with focused tests.
features.evidence: Actor report: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-03-durable-long-task-runtime-report.md; critic artifact: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-03-durable-long-task-runtime-critic.md; validations: focused ARO-03 ruff passed, focused checkpoint tests 5 passed, assistant runtime contract 37 passed, run-state contract 20 passed.
features.notes: ARO-03 added additive assistant_run_checkpoints storage, gateway checkpoint save/fetch and resume-preparation helpers, AgentLoop checkpoint writes, and /runs/{run_id}/resume. Checkpoints store bounded summaries/hashes rather than raw prompts or full tool args; failed resume records resume_blocked.

features.description: Context, prompt-cache, reasoning, and tool-selection optimizations are measurable, configurable, and protected by quality gates.
steps: Emit prompt-prefix hash, provider cache token metrics, TTFT, context utilization, and reasoning/cost telemetry into traces or eval summaries.
Stabilize tool schema ordering and cache-relevant message construction.
Gate adaptive routing or embedding tool selection with offline eval and rollback config.
features.evidence: Actor report: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-04-performance-cost-and-context-optimization-report.md; critic artifact: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-04-performance-cost-and-context-optimization-critic.md; validations: focused ARO-04 ruff passed, cache/context focused tests 8 passed, assistant context tests 29 passed, eval quality gate 26 passed.
features.notes: ARO-04 added trace-safe prompt-prefix and tool-schema hashes to context_budget, provider cache token normalization for OpenAI/DashScope/Gemini/Anthropic usage, context utilization telemetry, and deterministic tool-selector tie-breaks. Adaptive routing and embedding selector rollout remain disabled/not implemented until eval evidence exists; no latency or cost-savings claim was made.

features.description: A whole-demand release gate proves middleware, approvals, trace feedback, checkpoint/resume, and performance/cost policies together, with ADR/runbook handoff.
steps: Run backend, eval, assistant, web, harness, and open-source config regression gates appropriate to changed files.
Publish ADR/runbook decisions and no-go SLO thresholds.
Update feature oracle, progress log, continuity ledger, handoff, and next-window prompt for final state.
features.evidence: Actor report: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-05-release-regression-and-operating-model-report.md; critic artifact: deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/reports/aro-05-release-regression-and-operating-model-critic.md; validations: make verify-eval-dev passed, make validate-example-config passed, ARO-05 completion gate passed, full harness completion gate passed.
features.notes: ARO-05 ran the whole-demand release regression bundle, validated open-source example config, published deploy/runbooks/assistant-runtime-optimization/operating-model.md with decisions, rollback boundaries, trusted commands, SLO/no-go thresholds, and no-deploy rules. No deployment or production mutation was performed.
